description: This file contains a series of shell script tests verifying the behavior of 'git submodule absorbgitdirs', including setup, absorption of git directories into superprojects, handling nested submodules, nested worktrees, missing .gitmodules entries, and multiple worktrees in submodules.

methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive name

methods.name: test_must_be_empty

methods.name: test_when_finished
